scope: Static review of actual server-extracted write_lock function only; no import, network or execution.

lock_behavior.reentrant_scope: Same-thread threading.RLock plus per-root depth/fd state
lock_behavior.path_validation: root.resolve(strict=True), regular lock file, O_NOFOLLOW/O_CLOEXEC when supported
lock_behavior.timeout: Bounded by monotonic deadline; failure raises TimeoutError
lock_behavior.release: Outermost exit unlocks flock/closes descriptor; RLock released in finally

conclusion: The normal per-card final ensure/write wrapper uses a separate OS lock. A Stage3 installer that holds only the publication flock plus BEGIN IMMEDIATE has not thereby acquired the spec lock. Exact active background refresher write paths still need their dependency bodies, but this helper cannot be cited as automatic publication-lock coverage.
